positive_triggers: Turn my clarified learning goal and current baseline into an ordered study plan.
Revise my learning route because I can study less time each week now.
Help me plan prerequisites, practice, milestones, and ways to check progress toward this exam.
negative_triggers: I am still unsure what I want to learn; help me explore possible goals.
Teach the next confirmed lesson from my existing plan.

behavioral_evaluation.prompt: My confirmed goal is to learn enough Python to analyze CSV data. I know basic spreadsheet formulas but have never programmed. I can study about four hours each week. Propose a plan, but do not create a journal.
pass_criteria: Uses the confirmed goal, baseline, and available time without inventing deadlines or qualifications.
Orders topics by prerequisites and includes practice, milestones, and evidence of progress.
Labels any duration estimate as an estimate and explains material uncertainty.
Presents a draft for learner review and does not create a journal or workspace.
